description: Evaluate statutory Intrastat reporting obligations for cross-border physical goods movement (dispatches and arrivals) across all 27 EU Member States and Northern Ireland.

annual_arrivals_eur.description: Total annual value of goods received from other EU Member States in EUR

annual_dispatches_eur.description: Total annual value of goods shipped to other EU Member States in EUR

arrivals_unsure.description: Set to true if arrival volume is unknown

business_country.description: Two-letter ISO country code of establishment (e.g. DE, FR, PL, IT, ES)

business_subdivision.description: Optional regional overlay (pass 'NI' for Northern Ireland)

dispatches_unsure.description: Set to true if dispatch volume is unknown

language.description: Response language: en, ru, es, zh-CN

name: intrastat_threshold_check
